## Provenance declaration

- [ ] I authored this change or documented every part I am authorized to use.
- [ ] I used only sources permitted by `provenance/SOURCE_POLICY.md`.
- [ ] I listed all implementation-relevant research sources and what they
      informed, or this change used none.
- [ ] I declared all generated or AI-assisted material, including tools,
      inputs, prompts or commands, and human review, or this change used none.
- [ ] I added no confidential, leaked, decompiled, minified, or otherwise
      restricted material.
- [ ] Every commit has an accurate `Signed-off-by` trailer.

## Dependencies and assets

- [ ] This change adds no dependency, external asset, font, model, binary,
      vendored code, or remote import.
- [ ] Or, each addition is approved in `provenance/dependencies.json`, and all
      required notices and license texts are included.

List additions or state `None`:

## Tests and verification

Describe the tests, their derivation, and the commands or review performed.

- [ ] Tests and fixtures are original or have approved provenance.
- [ ] The documented verification is reproducible.
- [ ] Security, accessibility, numerical, and browser impacts were considered
      where relevant.

## User-interface and identity review

- [ ] This change has no user-interface, wording, icon, sample, branding, or
      product-identity impact.
- [ ] Or, the affected material is original or approved, and its design
      rationale and provenance are linked above.

## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Scope and behavior match the approved requirement.
- [ ] Provenance declarations are complete and credible.
- [ ] Dependency and notice records agree with the submitted files.
- [ ] Required technical, security, and provenance approvals are present.
